title: Appium: one driver for Android and iOS

videos.script: Appium tests an app from outside, the way a person would. It taps what is on the screen and reads what is written there. {{outside}} And it does that over HTTP. Your test sends a request, Appium does the tap on the phone, and the answer says what happened. {{http}} That is the same protocol a browser test uses on the web. So one client library can drive Android and iOS, and the code barely changes. {{one-client}} In this lesson you install Appium into the boxoffice project, with the driver for Android, and ask it whether your computer is ready. {{install}} Then you hold a whole session by hand, with curl. Every step a test takes is one request you can read. {{by-hand}} Then the same steps as a test for Tickets, in JavaScript. {{test}} And last, the two habits that decide whether such a test can be trusted. How it finds an element, and how it waits for one. {{habits}}
